subject: Nemo Health — private/on-prem deployment & contract requests
messages:
From: Clara Moreno <clara.moreno@nemohc.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-28T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: Private deployment: requirements and commercial ask

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Nemo Health is excited about Redwood's latency and cost profile. To move forward we need to discuss a private/on-prem deployment option and a few contract items that are make-or-break for our compliance team: 

- Residency: all patient data must remain in our US-East region and may not be replicated outside the region (including backups) without prior written consent.
- KMS/HSM: customer-managed keys required; integration with our HSM is mandatory.
- Audit rights: Nemo requires an annual on-site audit with a 30-day notice window (we prefer no limitations on scope).
- Egress: strict egress restrictions; logs and telemetry can be shared but raw payloads must never leave our network.
- Commercial: to justify the integration effort we need a 15% committed-capacity discount for a 24-month reserved term.
- Indemnity: standard indemnity carveouts in your T&C are problematic for us; legal is asking for broader indemnity around PHI exposures.

I've attached the draft SOW and our security questionnaire for your team to review (Nemo_SOW_v1.pdf; Nemo_Security_Q_2026.xlsx). Please advise what Redwood can accept so we can proceed to procurement.

Clara
Clara Moreno
Dir., IT Procurement | Nemo Health
clara.moreno@nemohc.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: Nemo_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf), Nemo_Security_Q_2026.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Private deployment: requirements and commercial ask

Team — forwarding Nemo's ask from Clara. Short summary: on-prem/private deployment into US-East only, HSM/KMS integration, annual on-site audit (30 days notice), strict egress/no raw payloads out, and a 15% discount request for 24 months plus indemnity changes.

Can you triage:
- Priyom: technical feasibility and operational overhead (deployment runbook, monthly premium, on-call support).
- Olga: legal risk on indemnity and audit scope; redline recommendation.
- Vivek: need exec direction on discount and any business exceptions for indemnity / residency constraints.

I attached the SOW they sent (Nemo_SOW_v1.pdf). Clara, will loop back with a timeline once we have internal feedback.

Thanks,
Aisha

Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment: requirements and commercial ask

Thanks — quick tech read:

1) On-prem / customer-hosted package: feasible but non-trivial. We need a dedicated deployment team to run the initial install, plus a hardened image and connectors. Expect a one-time professional services window (2–4 weeks) and a monthly private-hosting surcharge (I estimate $18k–$25k/month depending on redundancy).

2) HSM/KMS: we can integrate with customer-managed HSMs but with limitations. If Nemo insists on full key custody (no backup keys retained by Redwood), recovery and support are severely constrained; we need documented fallback procedures and an escrow arrangement for emergency key recovery.

3) Audit/on-site: an annual on-site audit is acceptable if we can define a narrow scope (SOC2 controls for hosting, network diagrams, and access logs). Unrestricted access or short notice audits are operationally disruptive. Recommend: limit on-site audit to once per 12 months, Redwood to receive 60 days' notice, and Redwood to approve the auditor from a short, pre-agreed list. We can provide SOC2 and penetration test reports as standard.

4) Egress: we can implement filters to prevent raw payload egress, but this increases CPU and storage overhead; expect additional cost and possible throughput impact.

Counter-proposal (technical): 10% committed discount + $20k/month private deployment premium + limited audit scope (60-day notice) + customer KMS with agreed escrow.

Attaching a brief runbook outline that lists the steps and required customer resources.

—Priyom
Principal Infra Engineer, Deployments
priyom_das@redwood.com

Attachment: deployment_runbook_outline.md

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment: requirements and commercial ask

Legal notes — high level: 

- Indemnity: Nemo's ask to broaden indemnity for PHI is risky. Recommend we offer to indemnify only for Redwood's negligence and willful misconduct, with a monetary cap equal to one times the annual contract value (1x ARR). Do NOT accept uncapped liability.

- Audit scope: agree to SOC2 documentation and controlled evidence. For on-site audits, we must require a scoped, mutually agreed statement of work for any physical inspection; limit to once per year and require 45–60 days' notice. We should also require that any extracted logs be redacted for PII and that customer bear costs for third-party auditors.

- KMS / HSM: customer-managed keys are acceptable if we have an escrow mechanism and a narrowly defined emergency recovery process. No broad language allowing customer unrestricted access to Redwood systems.

Commercial: I do not support a 15% discount off list for a two-year term without additional revenue commitments or an increased monthly premium for the private deployment. Suggest an approved sweet spot: 12% discount for a 24-month commitment combined with a private-hosting surcharge and documented SOW.

Link to my initial redlines: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/xyz-nemo-redlines — see Nemo_SOW_redline_v3.docx.

If we need an exec sign-off, propose we present the counter: 12% discount, 24-month committed term, 1x ARR indemnity cap, on-site audit limited to once/year with 45-day notice, and $20k/month private deployment premium.

—Olga
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Clara Moreno <clara.moreno@nemohc.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Private deployment: requirements and commercial ask — Exec direction

Team — thanks for the analysis. Executive decision and conditions below (we can take this to Nemo as Redwood's firm counter):

1) Commercial: Approved discount = 12% for a 24-month committed capacity agreement. The customer must also accept a private-deployment premium of $20,000/month to cover dedicated ops and support. Finance to update deal pricing; Aisha, please confirm the final ARR math before sending to customer.

2) Indemnity/liability: We will not accept uncapped liability. Cap liability at 1x ARR. Accept indemnity limited to Redwood negligence/willful misconduct and PHI breaches where Redwood is at fault.

3) KMS/HSM: We will permit customer-managed keys with an escrow for emergency key recovery. Technical team to produce a short MOU describing the escrow / recovery flow. No unrestricted customer access to Redwood internal systems.

4) Audits: Allow annual on-site audits limited to infrastructure & controls in the SOW. Require 45 days' notice, Redwood to approve auditor from a pre-agreed list, and customer to bear audit costs. Provide SOC2 and pen-test reports proactively.

5) Egress and logging: Agree to strict egress controls for raw payloads; customer must accept potential performance impacts and assume incremental costs for throughput.

6) Final step: Aisha, send an updated SOW/redline with these terms to Clara and Nemo Legal. Include Nemo_SOW_redline_v3.docx link and call out the $20k/month premium. Request a legal call with Nemo if they push on uncapped indemnity.

I'll provisionally sign off on these conditions; escalate to me only if Nemo refuses the indemnity cap or the price premium.

—Vivek
VP, Commercial
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

CC: Clara — please review the counter and let us know whether Nemo can accept the premium and the limited audit/indemnity scope.

Attachment referenced: Nemo_SOW_redline_v3.docx
